$comment: Knowledge Engine — read-only source extract plan (issue #19, M4). A manifest is DATA declaring which out-of-process scans may run: each scan names a kind, a declared root alias (values resolve per run via --root alias=path > DET_KB_ROOT_<ALIAS> > .toolkit/local.json) and an alias-relative subPath. The extract step opens only paths that pass the structural deny-list plus additive globs and the realpath-containment gateway, never writes inside any source root, and never writes the KB store — outputs are record-shaped JSON files consumed later by det kb ingest. Root alias VALUES never appear in any committed artifact.
title: Knowledge Engine — KB source extract manifest

id.$comment: Platform family the scans describe, e.g. 'magento'.

version.$comment: Pinned platform version expected, e.g. '2.4.8-p5'. A scan observing a different declared platform version emits a diagnostic.

description.$comment: What this alias is expected to point at — descriptions only, never paths.

rootAliases.$comment: Declared alias NAMES only — never values. Every scan rootAlias must be declared here (ROOT_ALIAS_UNDECLARED otherwise); values resolve per run through the same gateway as ingest.

kind.$comment: magento-platform: module/config/platform declarations (KB-1, includes recordType 'module'). pagebuilder-native / secomm-uiwidget / hyva-ui: KB-2 metadata-only inventories.

subPath.$comment: Alias-relative directory bounding this scan; empty/absent = the root itself. Never absolute, never traversal.

options.$comment: Bounded scalar options, documented per kind by the adapter. Unknown options are a scan error — never ignored.

denyGlobs.$comment: ADDED to the structural baseline for this scan (never replaces it). Glob syntax: ** crosses directories, * stays in one segment, ? matches one character.

uiRecords.$comment: kb-ui-component-array output path (pagebuilder-native + secomm-uiwidget + hyva-ui records).

output.$comment: Output-dir-relative targets. null disables writing that artifact even under --out; absent --out means report-only regardless.

denyGlobs.$comment: Manifest-wide additive deny globs applied to every scan, in addition to per-scan denyGlobs and the structural baseline.

outputFile.$comment: Relative to the --out directory; never absolute, never traversal. null disables this artifact.
